name: Travel Document 3
definition: Details of travel document used for identification and/or authentication of the customer.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of travel document. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identification of travel document (for example, passport number).

ExpirationDate.name: Expiration Date
ExpirationDate.definition: Expiration date of travel document (if and when relevant).
